_readme: Trips for docs/photos/index.html, newest first. Each trip: name, year, optional parts (a muted second line naming what is in it), optional time (races), optional note, tags, photos (src without .jpg, alt). A tag listed in filters becomes a filter link. After editing, run: python3 tools/build_photos.py
